blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has ordered the Bureau of Immigration (BI) to immediately release businessman Joseph Cue Sy, Global Ferronickel Holdings Inc. chairman, upon the posting of a P900,000 bond. In a resolution issued by its First Division on October 7, the high court granted the prayer for a writ of preliminary mandatory injunction filed by Dante R. Bravo on behalf of Sy. The SC directed the BI to release Sy upon proof of the bond and submit a written compliance report within 24 hours.
